title: Co$^2$ODE: Conditionally Coarse-Grained Model Discovery for Rewiring in Biochemical Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Biochemical networks propagate the signals that regulate cellular behaviour, and which routes carry them depends on cellular context: a shift in context rewires the network's effective dynamics. Mechanistic simulators are misspecified here because the effective dynamics emerge from an interaction structure that is only partially known. Model discovery instead learns the dynamics from data, but sparse, correlated measurements poorly identify a full network model. What matters is narrower: the portion the context rewires. We introduce conditionally coarse-grained ODEs (Co$^2$ODE), which model that portion as a sparse neural or symbolic ODE: a conditional mask selects the markers carrying the rewiring, and a variational autoencoder compresses the remaining markers into a learnt closure term. On single-cell phosphoproteomic data spanning 30 cancer-relevant overexpressions, Co$^2$ODE compresses a 30-marker panel into a 10-dimensional state

translated_title: Co$^2$ODE：用于生化网络重布线的条件性粗粒化模型发现
translated_abstract: 生化网络传播调控细胞行为的信号，而哪些路径承载这些信号取决于细胞环境：环境的改变会重布线网络的有效动力学。由于有效动力学产生于仅部分已知的相互作用结构，机制模拟器在此会出现误设。模型发现方法则从数据中学习动力学，但稀疏且相互关联的测量难以准确识别完整的网络模型。而真正重要的范围其实更窄：即被环境重布线的那部分。我们提出条件性粗粒化常微分方程（Co$^2$ODE），将被重布线的那部分建模为稀疏的神经或符号ODE：条件掩码负责选择携带重布线信息的标志物，变分自编码器则将其余标志物压缩为一个学习到的封闭项。在涵盖30种癌症相关过表达的单细胞磷酸化蛋白质组数据上，Co$^2$ODE将30个标志物的面板压缩为10维状态。
tldr: 提出条件性粗粒化ODE模型Co$^2$ODE，通过条件掩码仅对生化网络中被细胞环境重布线的标志物进行稀疏神经/符号动力学建模，并利用变分自编码器将剩余标志物压缩为学习到的封闭项，从而从稀疏单细胞数据中高效发现癌症相关的网络重布线动力学。
en_tdlr: Co$^2$ODE discovers context-dependent rewiring in biochemical networks by modeling only the rewired portion as a sparse neural or symbolic ODE selected by a conditional mask, while a variational autoencoder compresses the remaining markers into a learned closure term.
